connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace co.workix, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
